```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
        # Clip outliers / right-censoring 
        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")
        data['VehAge'] = data['VehAge'].clip(upper=20)
        data['DrivAge'] = data['DrivAge'].clip(upper=90)
        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)
        data['ClaimNb'] = data['ClaimNb'].clip(upper=5)

        # One-hot encode categorical variables
        self.actions_log.append("One-hot encoding Area, VehBrand, VehGas, Region.")
        data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=['Area', 'VehBrand', 'VehGas', 'Region'])

        # Normalize numerical variables
        self.actions_log.append("Normalizing numerical variables (VehPower, VehAge, DrivAge, BonusMalus, Density).")
        num_vars = ['VehPower', 'VehAge', 'DrivAge', 'BonusMalus', 'Density']
        data[num_vars] = (data[num_vars] - data[num_vars].mean()) / data[num_vars].std()

        # Engineer interaction terms
        self.actions_log.append("Engineering interaction term between VehAge and DrivAge.")
        data['VehAge_DrivAge'] = data['VehAge'] * data['DrivAge']

        # Validate distribution of ClaimNb
        self.actions_log.append("Validating distribution of ClaimNb for skewness.")
        if data['ClaimNb'].skew() > 1:
            data['ClaimNb'] = np.log1p(data['ClaimNb'])

        empty_cols = data.columns[data.isna().all()].tolist()
        if empty_cols:
            data = data.drop(columns=empty_cols)
        
        # Remove missing values
        data = data.dropna()
    
        return data
```
